rows.reasoning: Thompson voted Yea on third reading of HJR 3 (2014), a single-subject joint resolution whose operative text adds to the Indiana Constitution: "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text defines marriage as only between one man and one woman and bars any same-sex marriage from being valid or recognized in the state, matching the rung "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman." The tally of 57 to 40 is not near-unanimous, and the resolution's only subject is marriage, so the vote is not multi-subject.
